batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved CamScanner scan of the JU D Unit 2014-2015 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2014-2015-set2.pdf (6 pp.). ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED SET CODE DISCREPANCY: the Drive listing calls this file 'Set-2', but the printed header box on p.1 reads 'SET CODE: 3/4' — a merged pair code (Satt Academy's banks for this session are likewise merged pairs সেট ১/২ and ৩/৪). The printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2014-2015-set3-4. The compilation prints each question with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key; option labels are Bangla (ক)-(ঘ) for most questions and Latin (a)-(d) for some English/numeric ones, while the key boxes always use the Bangla letter (ক=a, খ=b, গ=c, ঘ=d). Printed header: session ২০১৪-২০১৫, D-ইউনিট (জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), 60 minutes, full marks 80, negative marking ০.২০ per wrong answer. The compilation prints no subject section headings; subjects were assigned per question by content (Biology split into Botany/Zoology by content block: Botany = printed Q17-36, Zoology = Q37-56), preserving printed order and numbering throughout. 80 questions: 78 keyed, 2 keyless (Q18 — key letter washed out in the scan and no ব্যাখ্যা printed; Q48 — key letter cut off at the page edge and no ব্যাখ্যা printed), 0 dual keys, 0 printed no-correct-option dispositions. Transcribed visually from 300 dpi renders read as quadrant tiles with native-resolution zooms for doubtful glyphs; render integrity verified by file hashes (p-1.png SHA-256 b8875d6beea2dd8985516391a7a0f12dba490f356c5d90c91230497244e002c2) and by crop-vs-full-page consistency throughout. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 34 of 80 questions verified. row 3: excluded (DIFFER) row 4: excluded (DIFFER) row 11: excluded (DIFFER) row 18: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 19: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 20: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 21: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 22: excluded (DIFFER) row 24: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 25: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 26: key conflict - Satt key (a) recorded, answer unverified row 28: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 29: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 30: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 32: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 33: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 34: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 35: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (DIFFER) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 42: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 44: excluded (DIFFER) row 46: key conflict - Satt key (d) recorded, answer unverified row 47: excluded (DIFFER) row 48: key taken from Satt (c) row 49: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 50: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 51: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 53: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 55: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 56: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 58: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 59: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 61: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 62: excluded (DIFFER) row 63: excluded (DIFFER) row 65: excluded (DIFFER) row 66: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 71: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 72: excluded (DIFFER) row 74: excluded (DIFFER) row 75: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 78: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 79: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 80: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

The Drive filename says set2, but the printed SET CODE box on p.1 reads 3/4 — the printed code governs the paper identity.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৪-২০১৫; D-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; boxed 'SET CODE: 3/4'; সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০. Printed instructions: (প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না) পরীক্ষার শুরুতে OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে নিচের দু'টি বাক্য লিখতে হবে — ১। নিয়ন্ত্রিত জীবন মানেই সুস্থ জীবন ২। Disciplined life means healthy life.
